newsitem.title: USA: Aetna Inc Q1 net operating income rises.
newsitem.headline: Aetna Inc Q1 net operating income rises.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Q1 1996 earnings exclude U.S. Healthcare, which merged with Aetna in July 1996.

Q1 1997 net income includes $0.72 per share benefit from reduction of reserve for anticipated future losses on discontinued products, and $0.10 charge for net realized capital loss. Q1 1996 net income includes $0.36 gain from net realized capital gain.
Q1 1997 operating earnings were $1.14 per share vs $1.07 per share for Q1 1996.
Excluding preferred dividend cost of $0.09 per share, 1997 net income per share was $1.76 vs $3.00 for Q1 1996.
First Call estimate for Q1 1997 was $1.05 per share.
